answer: Pay the challenge pool per distinct idea, not per key. Before rewards vest, each epoch's answers are embedded and clustered; any group whose texts trace the same argument with swapped words is treated as one author and splits a single share. A farm running one prompt across a hundred keys leaves a thread anyone can follow back to its source, so it earns one copper coin where it hoped for a hundred. Publish the cluster atlas each epoch so graders can audit every merge.
